visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a green knit beanie and a tan sweatshirt is shown leaning back in a black-and-orange gaming chair, eyes closed as if sleeping. A hand reaches in from the left and taps his shoulder. He jumps slightly, opens his eyes wide, and looks around in surprise, revealing a background of a crowded exhibition booth with a 'Monster Hunter' sign and wooden textures. (2) The man stands up and faces the camera in front of a massive 'Monster Hunter Wilds' backdrop wall that also features the Nitori logo. He speaks energetically, gesturing with his hands and waving at the camera. The setting is a brightly lit convention center with posters and game-related equipment visible in the depth. (3) The scene cuts to various shots of the booth, showing a wooden-textured wall with the Monster Hunter logo, display gaming chairs, and a large 'Lucky Draw' wheel labeled with game-related terms. Yellow variety captions and subtitles appear at the bottom. The background is filled with textures of wood and digital interface screens showcasing game merchandise. (4) The man demonstrates two different gaming chairs: a dark 'Zinogre' themed one with green accents and a white 'Ailu' cat themed one with purple and brown details. He sits in the white chair, pointing at the paw print details on the backrest and the lumbar support cushion. He adjusts the armrests and headrest, showing the chair's mechanical flexibility. (5) In the final segment, the man stands between the two showcased chairs, giving a thumbs up. He gestures towards a computer monitor displaying the Nitori website with Monster Hunter imagery. The background remains the busy exhibition hall with passers-by blurred in the distance under bright studio-style lighting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A soft tapping sound is heard, followed by a startled male gasp and short, confused vocalizations. An upbeat, high-energy electronic pop background music (BGM) swells in, featuring a driving drum beat and bright synthesizer melodies at approximately 124 BPM. The recording has a field recording quality with faint ambient booth noise. (2) The main male speaker begins an energetic narration with a high-pitched, excited tone and fast speech rate. His voice is clear but contains slight room resonance. A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect marks a visual transition. The BGM remains a constant, rhythmic foundation with a major tonality as he introduces the event venue. (3) The narration continues with high arousal as the speaker describes the booth activities and the collaboration between brands. Digital 'ding' and 'pop' sound effects are layered over the speech to emphasize variety text appearing on screen. Background crowd murmur and distant exhibition chatter create a low-intensity ambient noise floor. (4) The speaker's tone shifts to a more descriptive, informative style with moderate speech rate as he talks about product features such as the Ailu cat details. The sound of the chair being adjusted with mechanical clicks is briefly audible. The BGM maintains its tempo, providing a consistent energy level throughout the product demonstration. (5) The narration concludes with a friendly and authoritative call to action regarding pre-orders. A final riser SFX leads to the end of the clip. The signal-to-noise ratio remains high, with the vocal track well-balanced against the background music and ambient hall noise.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote the Nitori x Monster Hunter Wilds collaboration products, specifically gaming chairs and desks, by showcasing them at a booth during the Taipei Game Show. It uses an energetic vlog style to engage fans and provides information on pre-ordering.
